title: Genghis Khan
summary: Genghis Khan, born Temujin, probably in 1167 in northeastern Mongolia, founded the Mongol Empire, the most extensive land empire known to history. His supremacy was recognized at an assembly of princes and notables in 1206, after which the great Mongol conquests began. He died in late summer 1227 during his last campaign, against the Hsi Hsia, leaving the military foundation of an empire that kept expanding for half a century.

uncertainty.note: Birth year is placed around 1162 in World History Encyclopedia and 1167 in Encyclopaedia Iranica; death occurred in 1227.

audience_note: The Mongol conquests caused large-scale destruction and casualties across Central Asia, Iran, China, and eastern Europe.
